# Dealing with aphids

Mulch keeps the soil cool and slows evaporation during hot weeks. Pinch basil above a pair of leaves and it branches into two stems instead of one. Group plants with similar water needs together so one schedule fits the whole shelf.

## Why it matters

Water pots deeply and less often so roots grow down instead of staying near the surface. Mulch keeps the soil cool and slows evaporation during hot weeks. Succulents want a gritty mix with pumice or perlite so water drains within minutes.

A strong spray of water knocks aphids off; ladybirds finish the job if you let them. Compost needs a balance of green material for nitrogen and brown material for carbon. Succulents want a gritty mix with pumice or perlite so water drains within minutes.

## Checklist

- Compost needs a balance of green material for nitrogen and brown material for carbon.
- Group plants with similar water needs together so one schedule fits the whole shelf.
- Yellow lower leaves often mean overwatering rather than a lack of nutrients.
- Succulents want a gritty mix with pumice or perlite so water drains within minutes.
